results.content: 9118NMR characterization of the Tau/14-3-3 interface and modulation of this PPI by small molecules in the context of Alzheimer’s diseaseOur primary objective is to validate the Tau/14-3-3 interface as a drug target for future treatment of Alzheimer’s disease. In addition, based on our crystal structure of 14-3-3 bound to a Tau phosphorylated peptide, we have identified unique features in the interface of the 14-3-3/Tau complex that will provide the rationale for the development of inhibitors of this interaction as a potential new approach in AD therapy. ]]>As part of the MSCA mobility requirements candidates are eligible for this position when they have spent no more than 12 months of their main activity (work, study) in the last three years in France. **Cardiff University’s****College of Biomedical and Life Sciences****is looking to host talented postdocs as part of the European Commission's Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowships (MSCA-PF) scheme, who will work with our scientists on important projects, aimed at tackling major health and life sciences challenges.**.
